blocks.text: Adrenal cortex ke hormones ko corticosteroids kehte hain. In mein shamil hain:

items: Glucocorticoids, maslan cortisol aur us jaise steroids, glucose ka homeostasis (tawazun) qaim rakhte hain. Yeh muscle ke protein ko amino acids mein turwate hain, jinhein khoon jigar tak le jata hai. Yeh jigar mein gluconeogenesis (amino acids se glucose banana) bhi karwate hain.

Mineralocorticoids, maslan aldosterone, khoon mein minerals (namkiyat) ka tawazun rakhte hain. Aldosterone gurdon se peshab ka sodium wapas jazb karwata hai; is ke saath pani bhi wapas jazb hota hai. Yun khoon ki miqdar (volume) aur pressure normal rehte hain. Aldosterone gurdon se zaid potassium peshab mein bhi nikalwata hai.

blocks.text: Adrenal gland ke hormones ka adam tawazun

items: Adrenal medulla ke hormones zyada nikleen to hypertension (high blood pressure) aur rozmarra mein jarehana (aggressive) rawayya ho sakta hai. Kam nikleen to jism hangami (emergency) halat ka muqabla nahin kar pata.

Adrenal cortex se cortisol zyada nikle to Cushing disease hoti hai. Yeh tab hoti hai jab pituitary gland bohat zyada ACTH banaye aur adrenal glands bohat zyada cortisol banayein. Is mein protein bohat zyada toot'ta hai; nateeja: khoon mein sugar zyada, blood pressure zyada, patli haddiyan, muscles ki kami, patli aur nazuk jild, udasi (depression), aur auraton mein chehre par zyada baal.
Cortisol kam nikle to Addison's disease hoti hai: aam metabolic bigaar, muscles ki kamzori aur namkiyat (salts) ki kami. Is ki alamaat aam taur par aahista aahista zahir hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Kisi ko achanak khatra pesh aata hai. Adrenal gland ka kaunsa hissa jawab deta hai, aur us ka hormone bronchioles ke saath kya karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Adrenal medulla, jo nervous system ke qaboo mein hai, epinephrine (aur norepinephrine) chhorta hai. Yeh bronchioles ko phaila deta hai (dilation), saath hi dil ki dharkan, blood pressure aur khoon ka glucose barhata hai.

items: Har gurde ke oopar ek adrenal gland: andar medulla, bahar cortex.

Medulla (nervous system ka qaboo): epinephrine aur norepinephrine, fight or flight. Cortex (anterior pituitary ka qaboo): glucocorticoids (cortisol, glucose) aur mineralocorticoids (aldosterone, sodium, pani, potassium).
Cortisol zyada: Cushing disease; cortisol kam: Addison's disease.
